activeForm: Probing the undef PPI content in the tree walker
description:
FILED s402 (Opus 5).  Task #339 (iii) deleted the two blanket
`local $SIG{__WARN__} = sub { }` workarounds in the analysis-only parses
(Pl/VarAnnotator.pm ~699, Pl/Parser2.pm ~8415).  The ruling said to delete
them "if this warn was all they silenced" — MEASURED over both populations
(659 files, full-stderr scan, s402), it was not.  Two other things were being
hidden, and they are now visible:

  1. Pl/VarAnnotator.pm line 1005 — "Use of uninitialized value in pattern
     match (m//)", TWICE, on t/op/numconvert.t.  The line is

         if ($r eq 'PPI::Token::Symbol' && !@$kids && $node->content =~ /^\$\w+$/)

     so a node that IS a PPI::Token::Symbol has an undef ->content.  Worth one
     probe: either the node is a repaired/synthetic token with no content (then
     the repair pass is the bug) or ->content can legitimately be undef (then
     the guard belongs here).  Harmless today — the match just fails — but it
     is the same family as the ref='' undef node of #351.

  2. "Deep recursion on subroutine Pl::VarAnnotator::_tw_walk /
     _tw_operand_ok" on perl-tests/concat.t and t/opbasic/concat.t (2 lines
     each).  perl's depth-100 warning; the file is one enormous concatenation
     chain.  NOT a defect by itself — and note the SAME warning already prints
     unsilenced from Pl::CLForm::_flat (3193 times on t/comp/parser.t) and from
     Pl::Parser::_find_all_declarations (200 times), so the codebase already
     tolerates it.  Listed here only so the numbers are on the record.

REPRO: ./pl2cl --no-cache t/op/numconvert.t 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep VarAnnotator
(perl's t/, PCL_PERL_SUITE_T).

FILLER.  If Fable rules that the blanket silencer should come back instead,
the two `local $SIG{__WARN__}` lines are in the s402 commit's diff — but the
project rule is that the sin is the silence, so the deletion stands until then.

=== RULED s403 (Fable, docs/fable-answers-s402.md §2) ===
Deletion of the silencers STANDS.  Two halves: (1) the undef ->content is a
real defect — probe as above.  (2) the "Deep recursion" lines are perl's
depth-100 heuristic on tree walkers where depth > 100 is EXPECTED: add
`no warnings 'recursion';` INSIDE _tw_walk / _tw_operand_ok, and also inside
Pl::CLForm::_flat (3193 firings on t/comp/parser.t) and
Pl::Parser::_find_all_declarations (200) — the narrowest lexical form with a
comment saying why; NEVER a $SIG{__WARN__} handler.  Filler-sized.
subject: Uninitialized ->content in VarAnnotator _tw_walk (t/op/numconvert.t) — one of the two signals the deleted blanket warn-silencer was hiding
